history.content: ok so. weird thing. i deleted my linkedin yesterday and i havent felt this still in a long time
That “still” feels important. It sounds like something shifted when you deleted LinkedIn, and the quiet of it has been sitting with you since then.
yeah. i didnt even announce it or anything. just. gone. been on there since i was 22
That sounds like a quiet kind of relief, with a little gravity in it too. Deleting something you’d carried since 22 can make the silence feel bigger than the act itself.
relief is part of it i think. the whole thing was just me performing a version of myself i stopped believing in. job titles. 'thrilled to announce'. all that
Yes, that sounds like relief from the performance, and maybe a kind of honesty too. What did it mean to let go of that version of yourself?
honestly it meant admitting i dont want the thing i spent ten years telling everyone i wanted. the ladder. the senior whatever title. i kept curating this person who had it together

That sounds like a hard kind of honesty, not just about the title but about who you’d been trying to be. I’m wondering if the stillness came from no longer having to hold that version together, or from something else?
i think its that. like nobodys watching the dashboard anymore. no metrics on who i am. i woke up today and didnt reach for my phone to check anything and i just. lay there. and it was fine
That sounds like letting go of being measured, and finding out you could just lie there and be fine. I’m learning that the stillness is tied to no longer having to perform for the dashboard.
yeah. thats it exactly. its weird to feel safe being a person nobody can look up. like i got smaller and it felt like more room not less
That feels like a real shift, smaller but with more room, and that can be its own kind of safety. If you want, we can stay with what that safety is like, or leave it here.
maybe just one more sec. i guess im a little scared its temporary. that monday ill panic and reinstall. but right now its just quiet and im not gonna ruin it by poking it
That quiet, and not wanting to poke at it, comes through very clearly. It sounds like the fear is hovering in the background, while the quiet is what’s here right now.
yeah. the quiets here. thats enough for now. thanks for not making me name it til i was ready. gonna go sit with it
Of course. I’m glad you can sit with it, and I’ll leave it there with you.
